evals.prompt: An API change adds a tenant-scoped resource and changes its durable owner record. Route every independent axis.
evals.expected_output: Select both API-contract and data-architecture specialists.
assertions: Selects go-api-contract-spec and go-data-architecture-spec as independent primary owners.

evals.prompt: A requested change has no affected Go specialist axis.
A changed accepted retry budget violates reliability policy; no other axis changes.
assertions: Selects go-reliability-review and rejects neighboring owners.

evals.prompt: A new endpoint has no accepted authorization policy. Route without inventing it.
evals.expected_output: Route the missing decision to go-security-spec.
assertions: Names go-security-spec as the unresolved decision owner and invents no policy.
